_comment: Expected outcome for tests/fixtures/logs/web_idor_enumeration_combined.log. Only the stable fields are asserted -- incident_id, verdict_id and created_at are generated per run. The paired benign corpus is web_idor_benign_access_combined.log, which must produce nothing at all.
_incidents_comment: Two, not twelve: the crossing at five consecutive ids, then the escalation when the count doubled to ten. Duplicate suppression withholds the rest (talos.aggregation.suppress_duplicates).
_scope_comment: The final incident scopes the first ten ids. 8011 and 8012 arrived after the last escalation, so no report names them -- the known cost of per-escalation reporting, carried as a P8 calibration item.
